questions.question: Which of the following layers of the medallion architecture is most commonly used by data analysts?

choices.A: None of these layers are used by data analysts
choices.B: Gold
choices.C: All of these layers are used equally by data analysts
choices.D: Silver
choices.E: Bronze

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Tầng Gold chứa dữ liệu đã được tinh chỉnh theo nhu cầu phân tích và báo cáo, nên thường là điểm truy cập chính của analyst.

questions.question: A data analyst wants to connect Databricks to Fivetran using Partner Connect. Which statement correctly describes this setup?

choices.A: Partner Connect creates a new SQL warehouse and configures Fivetran to use it.
choices.B: Partner Connect creates a new cluster for Fivetran and starts an ingestion pipeline.
choices.C: Partner Connect creates a new schema and copies all source data into it automatically.
choices.D: The user selects an existing SQL warehouse (and a catalog if using Unity Catalog); Partner Connect generates a user-associated personal access token and opens Fivetran to finish setup.
choices.E: Fivetran runs inside Databricks SQL, so no partner account or connection is needed.

questions.explanation_vi:
**Đáp án D.** Hãy tách vai trò của hai bên: **Partner Connect khởi tạo kết nối**, còn **Fivetran cấu hình connector và đồng bộ dữ liệu**. Luồng thực tế là: trong Databricks, người dùng mở tile Fivetran, chọn SQL warehouse đang có (nếu warehouse đang dừng thì khởi động), rồi chọn catalog đích nếu workspace dùng Unity Catalog. Partner Connect tạo personal access token gắn với người dùng và mở trang Fivetran; tại đó người dùng đăng nhập hoặc tạo tài khoản, chọn nguồn dữ liệu, hoàn tất cấu hình connector và thiết lập lần đồng bộ. Chỉ chọn warehouse chưa làm dữ liệu chạy sang Databricks.

**Vì sao các phương án còn lại sai?**
- **A:** Partner Connect yêu cầu chọn một warehouse hiện có; nó không tự tạo warehouse mới.
- **B:** Luồng này dùng SQL warehouse đã chọn; không tự tạo cluster riêng hay lập tức chạy pipeline.
- **C:** Kết nối ban đầu không tự tạo schema rồi sao chép toàn bộ nguồn. Việc chọn catalog chỉ xác định nơi ghi; nguồn, cấu hình connector và lịch đồng bộ được hoàn tất trong Fivetran.
- **E:** Fivetran là dịch vụ đối tác bên ngoài Databricks. Người dùng vẫn phải mở Fivetran và hoàn tất tài khoản/kết nối.

questions.question: Which of the following describes how Databricks SQL should be used in relation to other business intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau, Power BI, and looker?

choices.A: As an exact substitute with the same level of functionality
choices.B: As a substitute with less functionality
choices.C: As a complete replacement with additional functionality
choices.D: As a complementary tool for professional-grade presentations
choices.E: As a complementary tool for quick in-platform BI work

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Databricks SQL phù hợp cho truy vấn và BI khám phá ngay trên lakehouse; nó bổ sung cho các công cụ BI chuyên sâu thay vì thay thế chúng.

questions.question: A data analyst wants to write and execute SQL queries in Databricks. Which page should they use?

choices.A: Data page
choices.B: Dashboards page
choices.C: Queries page
choices.D: Alerts page
choices.E: SQL Editor page

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** SQL Editor là nơi viết, lưu và chạy truy vấn SQL trong workspace Databricks.

questions.question: An analyst wants to divide one AI/BI dashboard into Development, Testing, and Production sections without creating separate dashboards. Which widget should they use?

choices.A: Use a separate SQL warehouse for each section.
choices.B: Create a separate dashboard for every section.
choices.C: Add text widgets with headings and formatted Markdown.
choices.D: Add filters for each section.
choices.E: Add dashboard parameters for each section.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Ô văn bản Markdown cho phép thêm tiêu đề và nội dung có định dạng để chia dashboard thành các phần rõ ràng.

questions.question: A data analyst needs to use the Databricks Lakehouse Platform to quickly create SQL queries and data visualizations. It is a requirement that the compute resources in the platform can be made serverless, and it is expected that data visualizations can be placed within a dashboard. Which of the following Databricks Lakehouse Platform services/capabilities meets all of these requirements?

choices.A: Delta Lake
choices.B: Databricks Notebooks
choices.C: Tableau
choices.D: Databricks Machine Learning
choices.E: Databricks SQL

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Databricks SQL cung cấp SQL warehouses, truy vấn, biểu đồ và dashboard; SQL warehouses có lựa chọn serverless.

questions.question: Which of the following should data analysts consider when working with personally identifiable information (PII) data?

choices.A: Organization-specific best practices for PII data
choices.B: Legal requirements for the area in which the data was collected
choices.C: None of these considerations
choices.D: Legal requirements for the area in which the analysis is being performed
choices.E: All of these considerations

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Xử lý PII phải tuân thủ đồng thời chính sách tổ chức và luật áp dụng tại nơi thu thập cũng như nơi xử lý dữ liệu.

questions.question: Delta Lake stores table data as a series of data files, but it also stores a lot of other information. Which of the following is stored alongside data files when using Delta Lake?

choices.A: None of these
choices.B: Table metadata, data summary visualizations, and owner account information
choices.C: Table metadata
choices.D: Data summary visualizations
choices.E: Owner account information

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Delta Lake ghi metadata và lịch sử giao dịch trong thư mục _delta_log bên cạnh các tệp Parquet.

questions.question: Which benefit of Databricks SQL is provided by Catalog Explorer?

choices.A: It can be used to write and schedule SQL queries.
choices.B: It can be used to view metadata and data, and to view or change permissions.
choices.C: It automatically converts dashboards into notebooks.
choices.D: It provisions SQL warehouses for every catalog.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Catalog Explorer cho phép khám phá metadata, xem dữ liệu mẫu và quản lý quyền của các đối tượng dữ liệu.

questions.question: A data analyst owns the managed table my_table and wants to transfer ownership to one other user using Catalog Explorer. Which action should they take?

choices.A: Share a dashboard that queries the table with the target user.
choices.B: Edit the table comment to include the target user name.
choices.C: Change the Owner field on the table page to the target user.
choices.D: Create a SQL warehouse owned by the target user.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Chủ sở hữu có thể chuyển ownership bằng cách chọn người dùng đích trong trường Owner của trang bảng.

questions.question: A data analyst has a managed table table_name in database database_name. They would now like to remove the table from the database and all of the data files associated with the table. The rest of the tables in the database must continue to exist. Which of the following commands can the analyst use to complete the task without producing an error?

choices.A: DROP DATABASE database_name;
choices.B: DROP TABLE database_name.table_name;
choices.C: DELETE TABLE database_name.table_name;
choices.D: DELETE TABLE table_name FROM database_name;
choices.E: DROP TABLE table_name FROM database_name;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** DROP TABLE xóa metadata của bảng managed và dữ liệu do bảng quản lý; các bảng khác trong schema vẫn tồn tại.

questions.question:
Given the rows below, which result is returned by this query? String comparisons use the values exactly as shown.

my_table(age, country): (75, canada), (74, canada), (76, canada), (80, usa), (NULL, canada), (90, canada)

SELECT age, country
FROM my_table
WHERE age >= 75 AND country = 'canada';

choices.A: (74, canada), (75, canada), (76, canada), (90, canada)
choices.B: (75, canada), (76, canada), (80, usa), (90, canada)
choices.C: (75, canada), (76, canada), (NULL, canada), (90, canada)
choices.D: (75, canada), (76, canada)
choices.E: (75, canada), (76, canada), (90, canada)

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** WHERE giữ lại các dòng thỏa cả hai điều kiện. SELECT chỉ trả về age và country, không trả về các cột khác.

questions.question:
A SQL UDF is defined as follows:

CREATE FUNCTION price(spend DOUBLE, units DOUBLE)
RETURNS DOUBLE
RETURN spend / units;

Which query applies it to customer_spend and customer_units in customer_summary and names the result customer_price?

choices.A: SELECT PRICE customer_spend, customer_units AS customer_price FROM customer_summary;
choices.B: SELECT price FROM customer_summary;
choices.C: SELECT function(price(customer_spend, customer_units)) AS customer_price FROM customer_summary;
choices.D: SELECT CAST(price AS DOUBLE) AS customer_price FROM customer_summary;
choices.E: SELECT price(customer_spend, customer_units) AS customer_price FROM customer_summary;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Gọi UDF bằng tên hàm và truyền hai cột làm đối số; alias customer_price đặt tên cho cột kết quả.

questions.question:
Consider the following two statements:
Statement 1:
```sql
SELECT * FROM customers LEFT SEMI JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id;
```
Statement 2:
```sql
SELECT * FROM customers LEFT ANTI JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id;
```
Which of the following describes how the result sets will differ for each statement when they are run in Databricks SQL?

choices.A: The first statement will return all data from the customers table and matching data from the orders table. The second statement will return all data from the orders table and matching data from the customers table. Any missing data will be filled in with NULL.
choices.B: When the first statement is run, only rows from the customers table that have at least one match with the orders table on customer_id will be returned. When the second statement is run, only those rows in the customers table that do not have at least one match with the orders table on customer_id will be returned.
choices.C: There is no difference between the result sets for both statements.
choices.D: Both statements will fail because Databricks SQL does not support those join types.
choices.E: When the first statement is run, all rows from the customers table will be returned and only the customer_id from the orders table will be returned. When the second statement is run, only those rows in the customers table that do not have at least one match with the orders table on customer_id will be returned.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** LEFT SEMI trả các dòng bên trái có ít nhất một dòng khớp; LEFT ANTI trả các dòng bên trái không có dòng khớp.

questions.question:
A data analyst has been asked to count the number of customers in each region and has written the following query:

```sql
SELECT region, count(*) AS number_of_customers
FROM customers
ORDER BY region;
```

If there is a mistake in the query, which of the following describes the mistake?

choices.A: The query is using count(*), which will count all the customers in the customers table, no matter the region.
choices.B: The query is missing a GROUP BY region clause.
choices.C: The query is using ORDER BY, which is not allowed in an aggregation.
choices.D: There are no mistakes in the query.
choices.E: The query is selecting region, but region should only occur in the ORDER BY clause.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** region không được tổng hợp nên phải nằm trong GROUP BY khi SELECT đồng thời với COUNT(*).

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of Databricks SQL using ANSI SQL as its standard SQL dialect?

choices.A: It has increased customization capabilities
choices.B: It is easy to migrate existing SQL queries to Databricks SQL
choices.C: It allows for the use of Photon's computation optimizations
choices.D: It is more performant than other SQL dialects
choices.E: It is more compatible with Spark's interpreters

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** ANSI SQL giúp giảm khác biệt cú pháp giữa các hệ thống, nhờ đó truy vấn hiện có thường dễ chuyển sang Databricks SQL hơn.

questions.question: The tables employees(employee_id, employee_name) and sales(employee_id, sale_amount) are updated as new sales arrive. Which statement creates sales_by_employee with each employee name and their total sales, while keeping results current when queried?

choices.A: CREATE TABLE sales_by_employee AS SELECT e.employee_name, SUM(s.sale_amount) FROM employees e JOIN sales s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_name;
choices.B: CREATE VIEW sales_by_employee AS SELECT e.employee_name, s.sale_amount FROM employees e JOIN sales s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id;
choices.C: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW sales_by_employee AS SELECT e.employee_name, SUM(s.sale_amount) FROM employees e JOIN sales s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_name;
choices.D: CREATE VIEW sales_by_employee AS SELECT e.employee_name AS sales_person, SUM(s.sale_amount) AS sales FROM employees e JOIN sales s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name;
choices.E: CREATE VIEW sales_by_employee AS SELECT employee_name, SUM(sale_amount) FROM employees GROUP BY employee_name;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** View lưu định nghĩa truy vấn chứ không chụp dữ liệu tại thời điểm tạo. JOIN ghép nhân viên với giao dịch, còn GROUP BY và SUM tính doanh số theo nhân viên.

questions.question: The sales_table has columns region, product_id, and sales. Which query calculates each product’s percent rank by sales within its region, with the lowest sales ranked first?

choices.A: SELECT product_id, region, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS pct_rank FROM sales_table;
choices.B: SELECT product_id, region, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales) AS pct_rank FROM sales_table;
choices.C: SELECT product_id, region, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales) AS pct_rank FROM sales_table;
choices.D: SELECT product_id, region, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sales) AS pct_rank FROM sales_table;
choices.E: SELECT product_id, region, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales) AS pct_rank FROM sales_table;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales) xếp hạng tương đối riêng trong từng vùng; ORDER BY xác định thứ tự doanh số.

questions.question: A sales table has region, product, and amount columns, with no NULL values in region or product. Which query returns totals for every combination of region and product, plus subtotals for each column and the grand total?

choices.A: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY region, product;
choices.B: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region, product);
choices.C: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region), (product));
choices.D: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY region;
choices.E: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY CUBE(region, product);

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** CUBE(region, product) tạo tổng hợp cho mọi tổ hợp nhóm của hai cột, gồm tổng phụ theo từng cột và tổng toàn bộ.

questions.question: A data analyst has been asked to produce a visualization that shows the flow of users through a website. Which of the following is used for visualizing this type of flow?

choices.A: Heatmap
choices.B: Choropleth
choices.C: Word Cloud
choices.D: Pivot Table
choices.E: Sankey

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Sankey biểu diễn luồng và độ lớn chuyển tiếp giữa các bước, phù hợp để xem đường đi của người dùng.

questions.question: A data analyst has been asked to configure an alert for a query that returns the income in the accounts_receivable table for a date range. The date range is configurable using a Date query parameter. The Alert does not work. Which of the following describes why the Alert does not work?

choices.A: Alerts don't work with queries that access tables.
choices.B: Queries that return results based on dates cannot be used with Alerts.
choices.C: The wrong query parameter is being used. Alerts only work with Date and Time query parameters.
choices.D: Queries that use query parameters cannot be used with Alerts.
choices.E: The wrong query parameter is being used. Alerts only work with dropdown list query parameters, not dates.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** SQL Alerts không hỗ trợ truy vấn có query parameter; cần đưa khoảng ngày vào logic truy vấn cố định hoặc dùng cách lập lịch khác.

questions.question: A data analyst is working with gold-layer tables to complete an ad-hoc project. A stakeholder has provided the analyst with an additional dataset that can be used to augment the gold-layer tables already in use. Which of the following terms is used to describe this data augmentation?

choices.A: Data testing
choices.B: Ad-hoc improvements
choices.C: Last-mile dashboarding
choices.D: Last-mile ETL
choices.E: Data enhancement

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Data enhancement là làm giàu tập dữ liệu hiện có bằng thông tin bổ sung từ nguồn khác.

questions.question: A data analyst runs the following command: INSERT INTO stakeholders.suppliers TABLE stakeholders.new_suppliers; What is the result of running this command?

choices.A: The suppliers table now contains both the data it had before the command was run and the data from the new_suppliers table, and any duplicate data is deleted.
choices.B: The command fails because it is written incorrectly.
choices.C: The suppliers table now contains both the data it had before the command was run and the data from the new_suppliers table, including any duplicate data.
choices.D: The suppliers table now contains the data from the new_suppliers table, and the new_suppliers table now contains the data from the suppliers table.
choices.E: The suppliers table now contains only the data from the new_suppliers table.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** INSERT INTO ... TABLE ... nối các dòng nguồn vào bảng đích; thao tác append không loại bỏ dòng trùng.

questions.question: Data professionals with varying titles use the Databricks SQL service as the primary touchpoint with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. However, some users will use other services like Databricks Machine Learning or Databricks Data Science and Engineering. Which of the following roles uses Databricks SQL as a secondary service while primarily using one of the other services?

choices.A: Business analyst
choices.B: SQL analyst
choices.C: Data engineer
choices.D: Business intelligence analyst
choices.E: Data analyst

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Data engineer thường làm việc chính với công cụ kỹ thuật dữ liệu và có thể dùng Databricks SQL như một dịch vụ bổ trợ.

questions.question: DESCRIBE EXTENDED accounts.customers shows Type = EXTERNAL and Location = s3://company-data/customers. An analyst runs DROP TABLE accounts.customers;. What happens?

choices.A: The table metadata and the S3 data files are both deleted.
choices.B: The table remains in the metastore, but its data files are deleted.
choices.C: The table metadata is removed; the files at s3://company-data/customers remain.
choices.D: The command fails because external tables cannot be dropped.
choices.E: The table is converted to a managed table before it is dropped.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Kết quả DESCRIBE cho biết đây là external table. DROP TABLE xóa đăng ký metadata nhưng không xóa các tệp tại LOCATION.

questions.question: Which Delta Lake feature makes concurrent reads and writes to a data lake reliable by committing table changes atomically?

choices.A: ACID transactions
choices.B: Flexible schemas
choices.C: Data deletion
choices.D: Scalable storage
choices.E: Open-source formats

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Delta Lake ghi nhận thay đổi trong transaction log và commit từng giao dịch theo cách nguyên tử. Nhờ đó, truy vấn không nhìn thấy một giao dịch ghi dở; các lựa chọn còn lại cũng có thể hữu ích nhưng không bảo đảm tính nhất quán khi đọc/ghi đồng thời.

questions.question: A query runs every four hours on a SQL warehouse, but each run spends too long waiting for compute to start. Which change can reduce startup delay while controlling cost?

choices.A: Reduce the warehouse size.
choices.B: Increase the warehouse size.
choices.C: Keep the warehouse running continuously between executions.
choices.D: Move the query to an all-purpose cluster.
choices.E: Use a serverless SQL warehouse.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Serverless SQL warehouse giảm độ trễ cấp phát compute khi truy vấn khởi chạy định kỳ và tự co giãn theo tải.

questions.question: Which of the following approaches can be used to ingest data directly from cloud-based object storage?

choices.A: Create an external table while specifying the DBFS storage path to FROM
choices.B: Create an external table while specifying the DBFS storage path to PATH
choices.C: It is not possible to directly ingest data from cloud-based object storage
choices.D: Create an external table while specifying the object storage path to FROM
choices.E: Create an external table while specifying the object storage path to LOCATION

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Với external table, LOCATION chỉ ra URI của dữ liệu trong object storage; Unity Catalog cần external location và quyền phù hợp.

questions.question: A data analyst is attempting to drop a table my_table. The analyst wants to delete all table metadata and data. They run the following command: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS my_table; While the object no longer appears when they run SHOW TABLES, the data files still exist. Which of the following describes why the data files still exist and the metadata files were deleted?

choices.A: The table's data was larger than 10 GB
choices.B: The table did not have a location
choices.C: The table was external
choices.D: The table's data was smaller than 10 GB
choices.E: The table was managed

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Bảng external chỉ quản lý metadata trong metastore; DROP TABLE không xóa dữ liệu ở vị trí lưu trữ bên ngoài.

questions.question: A user runs CREATE TEMP VIEW eur_customers AS SELECT * FROM stakeholders.customers WHERE country = 'France'; The query returns 15 rows. After logging out and back in two days later, what is the status of eur_customers?

choices.A: The temporary view remains available because its definition is stored permanently in Unity Catalog.
choices.B: The temporary view is no longer available because it existed only for the session that created it.
choices.C: The view metadata disappears but its query results remain accessible as a Delta table.
choices.D: The view remains available, but it returns no rows after logout.
choices.E: The temporary view is automatically converted to a managed table.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** CREATE TEMP VIEW tạo view tạm theo phiên. Khi phiên kết thúc, định nghĩa view không còn khả dụng.

questions.question: A data engineering team has created a Structured Streaming pipeline that processes data in micro-batches and populates gold-level tables. The microbatches are triggered every minute. A data analyst has created a dashboard based on this gold-level data. The project stakeholders want to see the results in the dashboard updated within one minute or less of new data becoming available within the gold-level tables. Which of the following cautions should the data analyst share prior to setting up the dashboard to complete this task?

choices.A: The required compute resources could be costly
choices.B: The gold-level tables are not appropriately clean for business reporting
choices.C: The streaming data is not an appropriate data source for a dashboard
choices.D: The streaming cluster is not fault tolerant
choices.E: The dashboard cannot be refreshed that quickly

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Làm mới dashboard gần như liên tục sẽ chạy truy vấn thường xuyên trên SQL warehouse và có thể làm tăng chi phí compute.

questions.question: In which of the following situations should a data analyst use higher-order functions?

choices.A: When custom logic needs to be applied to simple, unnested data
choices.B: When custom logic needs to be converted to Python-native code
choices.C: When custom logic needs to be applied at scale to array data objects
choices.D: When built-in functions are taking too long to perform tasks
choices.E: When built-in functions need to run through the Catalyst Optimizer

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Higher-order functions áp dụng lambda lên các phần tử ARRAY ngay trong Spark SQL, tránh xử lý từng phần tử bằng vòng lặp bên ngoài.

questions.question: In an AI/BI dashboard, an analyst adds a visualization widget without choosing a chart type. Which chart type is selected by default?

choices.A: Violin Chart
choices.B: Line Chart
choices.C: Bar Chart
choices.D: Histogram
choices.E: There is no default. The user must choose a visualization type.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Widget trực quan hóa mới trong AI/BI dashboard mặc định dùng biểu đồ cột (Bar chart). Có thể đổi kiểu biểu đồ sau khi tạo widget trong trình chỉnh sửa.

questions.question: Which of the following statements describes descriptive statistics?

choices.A: A branch of statistics that uses summary statistics to quantitatively describe and summarize data.
choices.B: A branch of statistics that uses a variety of data analysis techniques to infer properties of an underlying distribution of probability.
choices.C: A branch of statistics that uses quantitative variables that must take on a finite or countably infinite set of values.
choices.D: A branch of statistics that uses summary statistics to categorically describe and summarize data.
choices.E: A branch of statistics that uses quantitative variables that must take on an uncountable set of values.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Thống kê mô tả tóm tắt dữ liệu quan sát được bằng các số đo như trung bình, trung vị và độ phân tán; nó không suy luận toàn bộ tổng thể.

questions.question: In which of the following situations will the mean value and median value of variable be meaningfully different?

choices.A: When the variable contains no outliers
choices.B: When the variable contains no missing values
choices.C: When the variable is of the boolean type
choices.D: When the variable is of the categorical type
choices.E: When the variable contains a lot of extreme outliers

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án E.** Mean bị kéo mạnh bởi ngoại lệ, còn median ít nhạy hơn; nhiều giá trị cực đoan có thể làm hai số đo lệch đáng kể.

questions.question: In the Databricks SQL chart editor, where can an analyst set a custom color for a data series?

choices.A: Visualization Editor > Colors
choices.B: Query History > Display
choices.C: SQL Warehouse settings > Theme
choices.D: Dashboard schedule > Colors
choices.E: User Settings > SQL Editor

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Mở phần Colors trong Visualization Editor để chọn màu cho các chuỗi dữ liệu của biểu đồ. Đây là thiết lập của biểu đồ, không phải cấu hình warehouse hay lịch chạy dashboard.

questions.question: A data team has been given a series of projects by a consultant that need to be implemented in the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. Which of the following projects should be completed in Databricks SQL?

choices.A: Testing the quality of data as it is imported from a source
choices.B: Tracking usage of feature variables for machine learning projects
choices.C: Combining two data sources into a single, comprehensive dataset
choices.D: Segmenting customers into like groups using a clustering algorithm
choices.E: Automating complex notebook-based workflows with multiple tasks

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** JOIN là phép biến đổi quan hệ cốt lõi trong SQL để kết hợp các nguồn thành một tập dữ liệu phân tích.

questions.question: A data analyst schedules a Databricks SQL query to run regularly. Which statement about scheduled query execution is incorrect?

choices.A: A scheduled query requires a SQL warehouse to execute.
choices.B: The schedule controls when the query runs.
choices.C: A scheduled query does not use a SQL warehouse.
choices.D: A query schedule and an alert are separate features.
choices.E: The analyst can choose a warehouse for the scheduled run.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Truy vấn được lên lịch vẫn phải chạy trên một SQL warehouse được chọn; lịch chỉ xác định thời điểm chạy.

questions.question: A data analyst has created a query and wants two different visualizations from its result set on the same dashboard. Which approach should they use?

choices.A: They will need to alter the Query to return two separate sets of results.
choices.B: They will need to add two separate visualizations to the dashboard based on the same Query.
choices.C: They will need to create two separate dashboards.
choices.D: They will need to decide on a single data visualization to add to the dashboard.
choices.E: They will need to copy the Query and create one data visualization per query.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Một query có thể cấp dữ liệu cho nhiều visualization; thêm từng visualization dựa trên query đó vào cùng dashboard.

choices.A: array distinct(products)
choices.B: explode(products)
choices.C: reduce(products)
choices.D: array(products)
choices.E: flatten(products)

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** explode(products) tạo một dòng cho mỗi phần tử mảng và lặp lại các cột còn lại. Hàm này không loại phần tử trùng.

questions.question: Exact duplicate rows were found in table_bronze. Which query creates a new table table_silver containing the source rows with exact duplicates removed?

choices.A: CREATE TABLE table_silver AS SELECT DISTINCT * FROM table_bronze;
choices.B: CREATE TABLE table_silver AS SELECT * FROM table_bronze;
choices.C: CREATE TABLE table_silver AS MERGE DEDUPLICATE * FROM table_bronze;
choices.D: INSERT INTO table_silver SELECT DISTINCT * FROM table_bronze;
choices.E: INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE table_silver SELECT * FROM table_bronze;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** SELECT DISTINCT * loại các dòng trùng hoàn toàn trên mọi cột trước khi CTAS ghi kết quả vào bảng mới.

questions.question: How can a data analyst determine if query results were pulled from the cache?

choices.A: Open the query in Query History and check the result_from_cache metric in the query details or Query History API response.
choices.B: Go to the Alerts tab and check the Cache Status alert.
choices.C: Go to the Queries tab and click on Cache Status. The status will be green if the results from the last run came from the cache.
choices.D: Go to the SQL Warehouse tab and open Cache to view the cached file.
choices.E: Go to the Data tab and click Last Query.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Query History API có metric boolean result_from_cache; bảng system.query.history cũng có trường from_result_cache. Giá trị TRUE xác nhận kết quả đến từ result cache.

questions.question:
A data analyst must share a dashboard snapshot with an external client who must not receive access to the Databricks workspace or its other resources. The workspace admin has configured the client's email as an external notification destination.
Which approach cannot meet the security requirement?

choices.A: Download the Dashboard as a PDF and share it with the client.
choices.B: Set a refresh schedule for the dashboard and enter the client's email address in the "Subscribers" box.
choices.C: Take a screenshot of the dashboard and share it with the client.
choices.D: Generate a Personal Access Token that is good for 1 day and share it with the client.
choices.E: Download a PNG file of the visualizations in the dashboard and share them with the client.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** PAT là bearer token dùng quyền của tài khoản tạo token. Chia sẻ token có thể cấp quyền truy cập các tài nguyên workspace khác theo quyền của tài khoản đó; giới hạn thời hạn một ngày không giới hạn phạm vi quyền. PDF, ảnh chụp, PNG và email snapshot chỉ gửi nội dung dashboard.

questions.question: An analyst writes a query that contains a query parameter. They then add an area chart visualization to the query. While adding the area chart visualization to a dashboard, the analyst chooses "Dashboard Parameter" for the query parameter associated with the area chart. Which of the following statements is true?

choices.A: The area chart will use whatever is selected in the Dashboard Parameter while all or the other visualizations will remain changed regardless of their parameter use.
choices.B: The area chart will use whatever is selected in the Dashboard Parameter along with all of the other visualizations in the dashboard that use the same parameter.
choices.C: The area chart will use whatever value is chosen on the dashboard at the time the area chart is added to the dashboard.
choices.D: The area chart will use whatever value is input by the analyst when the visualization is added to the dashboard. The parameter cannot be changed by the user afterwards.
choices.E: The area chart will convert to a Dashboard Parameter.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Dashboard parameter có thể được nối với tham số của nhiều visualization; mọi thành phần dùng cùng tham số nhận cùng giá trị đã chọn.

questions.question: A data organization has a team of engineers developing data pipelines following the medallion architecture using Delta Live Tables. While the data analysis team working on a project is using gold-layer tables from these pipelines, they need to perform some additional processing of these tables prior to performing their analysis. Which of the following terms is used to describe this type of work?

choices.A: Data blending
choices.B: Last-mile dashboarding
choices.C: Data testing
choices.D: Last-mile ETL
choices.E: Data enhancement

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Last-mile ETL là bước biến đổi bổ sung trên dữ liệu Gold để đáp ứng yêu cầu riêng của một nhóm phân tích.

questions.question: A sales table has region, product, and amount columns. Which query returns totals by region and product, a subtotal for each region, and a grand total, but no product-only subtotal?

choices.A: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY CUBE(region, product);
choices.B: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY product;
choices.C: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region, product);
choices.D: SELECT region, product, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY region, product;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** ROLLUP(region, product) tạo các mức tổng hợp phân cấp: theo vùng và sản phẩm, tổng theo vùng, rồi tổng toàn bộ.

questions.question: What is an advantage of using a Delta Lake-based data lakehouse over classic enterprise data warehouse solutions?

choices.A: Open-source formats
choices.B: Schema enforcement
choices.C: ACID transactions
choices.D: Generic optimizations

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Định dạng mở của lakehouse giảm phụ thuộc vào một kho dữ liệu độc quyền và cho phép nhiều công cụ đọc dữ liệu.

questions.question:
A data analyst has opened up the SQL Editor page and written a new SQL statement. The data analyst now wants to save that statement to easily refer back to it later to add it to a dashboard. The results of the SQL statement must be able to be displayed as a counter, table, or a data visualization.
Which approach should the data analyst use to accomplish this task?

choices.A: Save the SQL statement as a Dashboard
choices.B: Save the SQL statement within a Notebook
choices.C: Save the SQL statement as a Query
choices.D: Save the SQL statement in the Query History page

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Lưu câu lệnh thành Query để dùng lại, tạo visualization và thêm các kết quả đó vào dashboard.

questions.question: An analyst receives a stakeholder dataset containing approved economic indicators and joins it to existing Gold tables to enrich a sales dashboard. Which common Databricks SQL analytics activity does this describe?

choices.A: Augmenting gold-layer tables with additional external information
choices.B: Automating complex notebook-based workflows with multiple tasks
choices.C: Testing the quality of data as it is imported from a source
choices.D: Segmenting customers into like groups using a clustering algorithm

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Ghép thêm dữ liệu ngoài vào Gold để bổ sung ngữ cảnh cho báo cáo là một dạng data enhancement trong phân tích.

questions.question:
A data analyst needs to query the data in my_table. They want to return the values in columns user_id and email_address where records fit the following filter criteria: age is greater than 25 and country is Canada. The analyst does not want to return values from any other columns.
Which code block will accomplish the above task?

choices.A: SELECT * FROM my_table WHERE age > 25 AND country = 'Canada';
choices.B: SELECT user_id, email_address FROM my_table WHERE age > 25 AND country = 'Canada';
choices.C: SELECT age, country FROM my_table WHERE age > 25 AND country = 'Canada';
choices.D: SELECT user_id, email_address FROM my_table WHERE age = 25 AND country > 'Canada';

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** SELECT chỉ định hai cột cần trả về; WHERE lọc theo tuổi và quốc gia mà không đưa cột điều kiện vào kết quả.

questions.question: What is a benefit of using Databricks SQL for business intelligence (BI) analytics projects instead of using third-party BI tools?

choices.A: Computations, data, and analytical tools on the same platform
choices.B: Advanced dashboarding capabilities
choices.C: Simultaneous multi-user support
choices.D: Automated alerting systems

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Lợi thế của Databricks SQL là compute, dữ liệu và công cụ phân tích nằm trên cùng lakehouse, giảm bước di chuyển dữ liệu.

questions.question:
Query History provides Databricks SQL users with a lot of benefits. A data analyst has been asked to share all of these benefits with their team as part of a training exercise. One of the benefit statements the analyst provided to their team is incorrect.
Which statement about Query History is incorrect?

choices.A: It can be used to troubleshoot slow running queries.
choices.B: It can be used to view the query plan of queries that have run.
choices.C: It can be used to debug queries.
choices.D: It can be used to automate query execution on multiple warehouses (formerly endpoints).

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Query History giúp xem và gỡ lỗi lần chạy trước; nó không phải bộ lập lịch để tự động chạy query trên nhiều warehouse.

questions.question: An analyst uses Partner Connect to connect Databricks to Tableau Desktop. Which sequence describes the current workflow?

choices.A: Select a Databricks compute resource, download the connection file, open it in Tableau Desktop, and complete authentication there.
choices.B: Partner Connect installs Tableau Desktop and its ODBC driver on the Databricks workspace.
choices.C: Partner Connect emails a permanent personal access token to every Tableau user.
choices.D: Export the SQL warehouse as a PDF, then import that PDF into Tableau.
choices.E: Create a dashboard in Databricks; Tableau reads it without a connection.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Partner Connect chọn compute, tải connection file và mở Tableau Desktop; người dùng hoàn tất phương thức xác thực trong Tableau.

questions.question:
A data analyst needs to notify stakeholders who cannot have Databricks accounts after each scheduled dashboard refresh. The workspace admin has configured their email addresses as external notification destinations.
Which approach requires the least manual effort?

choices.A: By granting the stakeholders’ email addresses permissions to the dashboard
choices.B: By adding the stakeholders’ email addresses to the refresh schedule subscribers list
choices.C: By granting the stakeholders’ email addresses to the SQL Warehouse (formerly known as endpoint) subscribers list
choices.D: By downloading the dashboard as a PDF and emailing it to the stakeholders each time it is refreshed

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Đăng ký email bên ngoài vào lịch dashboard để người nhận nhận snapshot sau mỗi lần chạy theo lịch. Họ không cần tài khoản Databricks; quản trị viên phải cấu hình địa chỉ email bên ngoài trước.

questions.question: In the legacy Hive metastore, a schema is created with CREATE SCHEMA accounting LOCATION 'dbfs:/accounting/data'; Where is the schema data stored?

choices.A: dbfs:/accounting/data/accounting.db
choices.B: dbfs:/accounting/data
choices.C: dbfs:/accounting/data.db
choices.D: dbfs:/user/hive/warehouse/accounting.db

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** LOCATION chỉ định chính xác thư mục lưu dữ liệu của schema trong ví dụ; hậu tố .db chỉ được thêm khi dùng vị trí mặc định.

questions.question:
A data analyst has written and saved a series of queries that reveal trends that need to be monitored by several stakeholders.
Which tool should the data analyst use to share the results of all of the queries to be viewed at once?

choices.A: A SQL warehouse (formerly known as a SQL endpoint)
choices.B: A Query History page
choices.C: A dashboard
choices.D: A data visualization tab on a Query page

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Dashboard gom nhiều query và visualization để người xem theo dõi cùng lúc.

questions.question: The tables customers(customer_id) and orders(order_id, customer_id) contain all customers, including those without orders. Which query returns every customer and the number of their orders?

choices.A: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id;
choices.B: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id;
choices.C: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id;
choices.D: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id;
choices.E: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM customers c RIGHT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** LEFT JOIN giữ cả khách hàng chưa có đơn; COUNT(order_id) đếm đơn khớp và trả 0 cho nhóm không có đơn.

questions.question: Which statement about visualizations is true?

choices.A: All visualizations must use the same data in order to be included in the same Databricks SQL dashboard.
choices.B: Line charts are the preferred visualization type for categorical data.
choices.C: Different visualizations can be used to tell different stories about the data.
choices.D: There is no difference between the bar chart and a histogram in Databricks SQL.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Mỗi loại visualization làm nổi bật một quan hệ khác nhau; chọn biểu đồ theo câu hỏi phân tích cần trả lời.

questions.question: What is used as a compute resource for Databricks SQL?

choices.A: Standard clusters
choices.B: Single-node clusters
choices.C: SQL warehouses
choices.D: Downstream BI tools integrated with Databricks SQL

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** SQL warehouse là compute resource dành cho truy vấn Databricks SQL và kết nối BI.

questions.question: A stakeholder gives an analyst a small CSV lookup file. Which current Databricks UI flow can quickly create a managed Delta table from the local file?

choices.A: Choose New > Add or upload data > Create or modify a table, upload the file, select a schema, and create the table.
choices.B: Use Partner Connect to install an ODBC driver that converts the CSV into a table.
choices.C: Paste the CSV into the SQL warehouse configuration page.
choices.D: Create an alert on the file and wait for Databricks to infer a table.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Tải CSV nhỏ qua New > Add or upload data > Create or modify a table để tạo managed Delta table.

questions.question:
A data analyst needs to create an empty managed table table_name in database database_name with a specific schema. The table needs to be recreated and empty, regardless of whether or not the table already exists.
Which command can the analyst use to complete the task?

choices.A: CREATE TABLE database_name.table_name USING (width INT, length INT, height INT);
choices.B: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE database_name.table_name USING (width INT, length INT, height INT);
choices.C: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE database_name.table_name (width INT, length INT, height INT);
choices.D: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE table_name FROM database_name USING (width INT, length INT, height INT);

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE với khai báo cột nhưng không có AS SELECT tạo bảng rỗng và thay thế bảng cùng tên nếu đã tồn tại.

questions.question:
A data analyst has two data sources that are providing similar but complementary information. The analyst wants to combine these sources of data into a single, comprehensive dataset for ongoing use for their team in a variety of different projects.
Which terms is used to describe this type of work?

choices.A: Last-mile ETL
choices.B: Ad-hoc improvements
choices.C: Data testing
choices.D: Data blending

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Data blending kết hợp dữ liệu từ các nguồn bổ sung để tạo một tập dữ liệu dùng chung cho phân tích.

questions.question: Some supplier_id values in new_suppliers may already exist in suppliers. Which command inserts only rows whose supplier_id is not already present?

choices.A: MERGE INTO suppliers AS t USING new_suppliers AS s ON t.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *;
choices.B: COPY INTO suppliers FROM new_suppliers;
choices.C: UPDATE suppliers SET supplier_id = new_suppliers.supplier_id;
choices.D: INSERT INTO suppliers SELECT * FROM new_suppliers;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** MERGE ghép theo supplier_id và chỉ INSERT khi không tìm thấy khóa khớp, nên các supplier đã có không bị chèn lặp.

questions.question:
A data engineering team has created a Structured Streaming pipeline that processes data in micro-batches and populates gold-level tables. The microbatches are triggered every 10 minutes.
A data analyst has created a dashboard based on this gold-level data. The project stakeholders want to see the results in the dashboard updated within 10 minutes or less of new data becoming available within the gold-level tables.
What is the ability to ensure the streamed data is included in the dashboard at the standard requested by the project stakeholders?

choices.A: A refresh schedule with an always-on SQL Warehouse (formerly known as SQL Endpoint)
choices.B: A refresh schedule with an interval of 10 minutes or less
choices.C: A refresh schedule with stakeholders included as subscribers
choices.D: A refresh schedule with a Structured Streaming cluster

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Lịch làm mới không dài hơn chu kỳ cập nhật dữ liệu giúp dashboard nhận các micro-batch mới trong ngưỡng 10 phút.

questions.question:
A data analyst wants to create a Databricks SQL dashboard with multiple data visualizations and multiple counters.
What must be completed before adding the data visualizations and counters to the dashboard?

choices.A: All data visualizations and counters must be created using Queries.
choices.B: A SQL warehouse (formerly known as SQL endpoint) must be turned on and selected.
choices.C: A markdown-based tile must be added to the top of the dashboard displaying the dashboard’s name.
choices.D: The dashboard owner must also be the owner of the queries, data visualizations, and counters.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Cần chọn SQL warehouse để thực thi query cung cấp dữ liệu cho visualization và counter.

questions.question: For each region, rank products by sales from highest to lowest. Tied sales must receive the same rank, and the next rank must contain a gap. Which query does this?

choices.A: SELECT region, product, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_table;
choices.B: SELECT region, product, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_table;
choices.C: SELECT region, product, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_table;
choices.D: SELECT region, product, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_table;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** RANK() với PARTITION BY region xếp hạng độc lập trong từng vùng; doanh số giảm dần đặt mức bán cao nhất ở hạng 1.

questions.question:
Data professionals with varying responsibilities use the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
Which role in the Databricks Lakehouse Platform use Databricks SQL as their primary service?

choices.A: Data scientist
choices.B: Data engineer
choices.C: Platform architect
choices.D: Business analyst

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Business analyst thường dùng Databricks SQL làm dịch vụ chính để truy vấn và phân tích dữ liệu.

questions.question: Which data visualization use cases is best completed using Databricks SQL relative to other visualization tools?

choices.A: Presentation-grade visualizations for publication
choices.B: Organization-branded visualizations for marketing material
choices.C: Custom, interactive visualizations on small data
choices.D: Simple, exploratory visualizations on big data

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Databricks SQL phù hợp với phân tích khám phá trực tiếp trên dữ liệu lớn; công cụ trình bày chuyên biệt phù hợp hơn cho báo cáo xuất bản.

questions.question: Which statement about subqueries is correct?

choices.A: Subqueries are not available in Databricks SQL.
choices.B: Subqueries can be used like other user-defined functions to transform data into different data types.
choices.C: Subqueries can retrieve data without requiring the creation of a table or view.
choices.D: Subqueries can be used like other built-in functions to transform data into different data types.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Subquery là truy vấn lồng trong câu SQL khác, có thể tạo tập kết quả trung gian mà không cần tạo bảng hoặc view.

questions.question: An analyst takes a Gold table and applies project-specific filters, joins, and calculations before building one team’s report. Which common analytics activity does this describe?

choices.A: Testing the latency of real-time streaming workloads
choices.B: Performing analysis-specific ETL on gold-layer tables
choices.C: Predicting customer churn by automatically developing time-series models
choices.D: Monitoring the performance of deployed machine learning solutions

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Last-mile ETL biến đổi Gold cho một phân tích cụ thể trước khi sử dụng; đây là công việc phổ biến trong Databricks SQL.

questions.question: The products column is an ARRAY. Which expression returns the first element from that array in Databricks SQL?

choices.A: products.1
choices.B: products.0
choices.C: products[0]
choices.D: products[1]

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Cú pháp products[0] lấy phần tử đầu tiên vì chỉ số ARRAY trong Spark SQL bắt đầu từ 0.

questions.question: Where in the Databricks SQL workspace can a data analyst configure a refresh schedule for a query when the query is not attached to a dashboard or alert?

choices.A: Data Explorer
choices.B: The Visualization Editor
choices.C: The Query Editor
choices.D: The Dashboard Editor

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Khi query không gắn với dashboard hay alert, có thể cấu hình lịch chạy từ SQL Editor.

questions.question: An organization uses the medallion architecture. Which query creates a new Gold table by aggregating sales from an existing Silver table?

choices.A: CREATE VIEW gold.sales_summary AS SELECT * FROM bronze.raw_sales;
choices.B: CREATE TABLE silver.sales_summary AS SELECT product_id, SUM(sales_amount) FROM gold.sales GROUP BY product_id;
choices.C: CREATE TABLE gold.sales_summary AS SELECT product_id, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales FROM silver.sales GROUP BY product_id;
choices.D: INSERT INTO silver.sales SELECT * FROM gold.sales_summary;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** CTAS đọc bảng Silver, tổng hợp theo product_id rồi tạo bảng Gold mới từ kết quả.

questions.question: Which location can be used to determine the owner of a managed table?

choices.A: Review the Owner field in the table page using Catalog Explorer
choices.B: Review the Owner field in the database page using Data Explorer
choices.C: Review the Owner field in the schema page using Data Explorer
choices.D: Review the Owner field in the table page using the SQL Editor

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Trang bảng trong Catalog Explorer hiển thị metadata, gồm chủ sở hữu của managed table.

questions.question: What describes the variance of a set of values?

choices.A: Variance is a measure of how far a single observed value is from a set of values.
choices.B: Variance is a measure of how far an observed value is from the variable’s maximum or minimum value.
choices.C: Variance is a measure of central tendency of a set of values.
choices.D: Variance is a measure of how far a set of values is spread out from the set's central value.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Variance đo độ phân tán quanh trung bình bằng cách tính trung bình bình phương độ lệch.

questions.question:
A report must list every customer and indicate whether that customer placed an order during the past year. Customers with no recent order must remain in the result. The date condition can be placed in the join condition.
Which join should the analyst use?

choices.A: Left Semi Join
choices.B: Left Join
choices.C: Middle Join
choices.D: Left Anti Join

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** LEFT JOIN giữ lại mọi dòng từ bảng customers. Đặt điều kiện ngày của orders trong ON, rồi kiểm tra orders.order_id IS NULL để nhận diện khách không có đơn phù hợp; đặt điều kiện orders trong WHERE sẽ loại các dòng NULL này.

questions.question: What describes Partner Connect in Databricks?

choices.A: It provides free use of Databricks partner tools through a common API.
choices.B: It simplifies connecting a Databricks workspace to supported partner solutions.
choices.C: It exposes connection information to third-party tools without requiring setup in the partner service.
choices.D: It runs partner tools inside a Databricks SQL Warehouse.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Partner Connect hướng dẫn và tự động hóa một phần cấu hình để nối workspace với dịch vụ đối tác được hỗ trợ. Công cụ đối tác vẫn chạy ở dịch vụ riêng và thường cần hoàn tất thiết lập tại đó.

questions.question:
A data analyst has come across a column in a table that contains personally identifiable information (PII). The data analyst should not have access to this type of PII data.
How should the data analyst proceed?

choices.A: Stop working with the data and delete the table and any existing metadata or data files.
choices.B: Stop working with the data and proceed with the project using other data.
choices.C: Stop working with the data and notify their supervisor to ensure the data is handled following organizational and legal best practices.
choices.D: Drop the column containing PII data and continue with the project without notifying anybody.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Dừng xử lý PII trái quyền và báo người phụ trách để dữ liệu được xử lý theo chính sách bảo mật, pháp lý.

questions.question:
A managed table and an unmanaged (external) table were both created in Databricks SQL, and data were ingested into each table. Later, both tables were dropped.
What is the status of data for each of those tables?

choices.A: The data in both tables were deleted.
choices.B: The data in the managed table were deleted, and the data in the unmanaged (external) table were left untouched.
choices.C: The data in the unmanaged (external) table were deleted and the data in the managed table were left untouched, for both tables the metadata was the same.
choices.D: The data in both tables were left untouched.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** DROP TABLE xóa dữ liệu managed sau thời hạn khôi phục (mặc định 7 ngày); tệp của external table vẫn ở vị trí bên ngoài.

questions.question:
A data scientist has asked a data analyst to create histograms for every continuous variable in a data set. The data analyst needs to identify which columns are continuous in the data set.
What describes a continuous variable?

choices.A: A quantitative variable that never stops changing
choices.B: A quantitative variable that can take on a finite or countably infinite set of values
choices.C: A quantitative variable that can take on an uncountable set of values
choices.D: A categorical variable in which the number of categories continues to increase over time

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Biến liên tục là biến định lượng có thể nhận vô số giá trị thực trong một khoảng, thay vì chỉ các mức đếm được.

questions.question: Which SQL standards does Databricks SQL use as its default SQL dialect?

choices.A: Databricks SQL
choices.B: Spark SQL
choices.C: ANSI
choices.D: Delta SQL

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Databricks SQL mặc định dùng ANSI mode cho các workspace mới; một số cú pháp Spark vẫn được hỗ trợ theo cấu hình.

questions.question:
A dashboard dataset query uses a Date parameter in its WHERE clause, and the parameter is displayed as a date-range widget.
What values does the widget provide to the query?

choices.A: A start date and an end date for the query to use in its WHERE clause.
choices.B: A start date and an end date that directly set the chart's x-axis range.
choices.C: A date range that automatically filters every visualization in the dashboard.
choices.D: A text label that only tells viewers which date range the dashboard represents.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Date parameter dạng Range cung cấp giá trị bắt đầu và kết thúc để thay thế tham số trong truy vấn dataset. Nó không tự đổi trục biểu đồ hay lọc mọi biểu đồ nếu các truy vấn không dùng tham số đó.

questions.question: In which scenario should a data analyst create and use a user-defined function (UDF)?

choices.A: When the result of logic needs to be restricted to certain users
choices.B: When logic needs to be deployed within a subquery
choices.C: When complex logic cannot be implemented with built-in capabilities
choices.D: When simple logic needs to be optimized for scaling purposes

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** UDF phù hợp khi logic cần thiết không thể biểu đạt hợp lý bằng các hàm tích hợp sẵn.

questions.question: In the Databricks SQL visualization editor, where can an analyst change a chart's y-axis scale or set a custom y-axis range?

choices.A: Query Editor -> Y Axis
choices.B: Dashboard Editor -> Axes -> Y Axis
choices.C: Visualization Editor -> Y Axis
choices.D: Settings -> User Settings -> Scaling

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Mở Visualization Editor của biểu đồ và cấu hình phần Y axis để đổi kiểu scale hoặc nhập phạm vi tùy chỉnh. Đây là thiết lập của biểu đồ, không nằm trong cài đặt chung của người dùng hay query editor.

questions.question: Which open-source project helps to enable the data lakehouse by adding organization, reliability, performance, and data governance to data lake architectures?

choices.A: MLflow
choices.B: Apache Spark
choices.C: Delta Lake
choices.D: Databricks SQL

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Delta Lake là lớp lưu trữ mở bổ sung giao dịch, schema enforcement, lịch sử phiên bản và tối ưu bố cục cho data lake.

questions.question:
The table my_table has customer_name and dollars_spent ARRAY columns:

Hex Sprockets | [125.34, 100.15, 9003.99]
Dented Fenders | [16.99, 200.85, 33.49, 88.17]

Which expression transforms every dollars_spent value by dividing it by 100 and names the result hundreds_spent?

choices.A: TRANSFORM(hundreds_spent, dollars_spent / 100)
choices.B: TRANSFORM(dollars_spent, value / 100) AS hundreds_spent
choices.C: TRANSFORM(dollars_spent, value -> value / 100) AS hundreds_spent
choices.D: TRANSFORM(dollars_spent, dollars_spent / 100) AS hundreds_spent

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** TRANSFORM nhận ARRAY và lambda; biểu thức value -> value / 100 biến đổi độc lập từng phần tử.

questions.question: Where can an administrator or data owner grant database, table, and view permissions to a group?

choices.A: Dashboard
choices.B: Catalog Explorer
choices.C: SQL Warehouses
choices.D: Settings

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Quyền trên catalog, schema, table và view được xem hoặc cấp trong Catalog Explorer ở khu vực Data.

questions.question:
A data architect has informed a data analyst team that its organization will now use a data design pattern that will logically organize data in a lakehouse, with the goal of incrementally and progressively improving the structure and quality of data as it flows through each layer of the architecture.
Which term is used to describe this data design pattern?

choices.A: Medallion architecture
choices.B: Change data feed
choices.C: Delta Lake
choices.D: Data mesh

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Medallion architecture tổ chức dữ liệu thành Bronze, Silver và Gold với chất lượng được cải thiện qua từng lớp.

questions.question: Which Databricks SQL action is used to audit and view the history of operations performed on a Delta Lake table in Databricks?

choices.A: Run a SELECT logs FROM table_name query
choices.B: Use the SHOW TRANSACTIONS table_name command
choices.C: Execute a VACUUM table_name statement
choices.D: Use the DESCRIBE HISTORY table_name command

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** DESCRIBE HISTORY hiển thị các phiên bản và thao tác đã ghi vào transaction log của bảng Delta.

questions.question: A Unity Catalog user has SELECT on a table and USE SCHEMA on its parent schema, but is missing USE CATALOG on the parent catalog. Which privilege should an administrator grant to allow access?

choices.A: OWNERSHIP on the table.
choices.B: MANAGE on the catalog.
choices.C: MANAGE on the table.
choices.D: USE CATALOG on the parent catalog.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Unity Catalog cần USE CATALOG và USE SCHEMA để truy cập namespace, ngoài SELECT trên bảng.

questions.question:
A data analyst is reviewing the status of alerts in the Databricks SQL Alerts listing page. One alert was recently executed, and the monitored value met the defined condition and exceeded the threshold, meaning the alert criteria were met.
Which status should appear for this alert in the listing?

choices.A: Status: YES
choices.B: Status: TRIGGERED
choices.C: Status: OK
choices.D: Status: SUCCESS

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** TRIGGERED là trạng thái của lần đánh giá gần nhất khi điều kiện cảnh báo được đáp ứng. OK cho biết điều kiện chưa được đáp ứng; ERROR nghĩa là truy vấn hoặc lần đánh giá gặp lỗi.

questions.question:
A data analyst wants to compare the contents of a Delta table as they existed last week to the current state in order to track changes in sales records.
Which Delta Lake feature enables this comparison?

choices.A: RESTORE command
choices.B: VACUUM retention settings
choices.C: Time travel querying
choices.D: CLONE with VERSION AS OF

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Time travel truy vấn phiên bản hoặc thời điểm trước của Delta table để so sánh với trạng thái hiện tại.

questions.question: Which Databricks capability, formerly called Genie Spaces, lets business users ask natural-language questions about curated tables and receive SQL-backed answers?

choices.A: Data Intelligence Engine
choices.B: Unity Catalog
choices.C: Genie Agent
choices.D: Databricks Assistant

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Genie cho phép hỏi dữ liệu bằng ngôn ngữ tự nhiên và sinh SQL trên các bảng đã được tuyển chọn, mô tả.

questions.question: The tags column is an ARRAY of strings. Which predicate returns rows whose array contains the value sql?

choices.A: tags = 'sql'
choices.B: tags IN ('sql')
choices.C: 'sql' IN tags
choices.D: array_contains(tags, 'sql')

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** array_contains(tags, 'sql') kiểm tra một phần tử cụ thể có nằm trong ARRAY hay không.

questions.question: A Unity Catalog table main.analytics.sales_data must be marked as certified using the governed certification status tag. Which SQL statement does this?

choices.A: SET TAG ON TABLE main.analytics.sales_data `system.certification_status` = `certified`;
choices.B: ALTER TABLE main.analytics.sales_data SET TAGS ('certified' = 'true');
choices.C: GRANT CERTIFY ON TABLE main.analytics.sales_data TO analyst_group;
choices.D: UPDATE TABLE main.analytics.sales_data ADD COMMENT 'Certified dataset';

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Gắn trạng thái chuẩn bằng governed tag system.certification_status = certified; cần quyền ASSIGN cho tag này.

questions.question:
A data analyst is troubleshooting a query in Databricks SQL that fails when processing large datasets and complex join operations. Logs indicate that the job consistently aborts due to resource constraint errors on the cluster.
Which Query Profile metric should the analyst use to identify the operator that is causing resource overuse?

choices.A: Time spent per operator
choices.B: Shuffle read size per operator
choices.C: Memory peak per operator
choices.D: Bytes spilled to disk per operator

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Peak memory theo operator cho biết bước nào giữ nhiều bộ nhớ nhất và có khả năng gây lỗi tài nguyên.

questions.question:
A data analyst encounters an unclear error while running a SQL query in the Databricks SQL Editor. The analyst wants to quickly understand and resolve the issue.
How can Databricks Assistant help the analyst diagnose and fix the error?

choices.A: Disable ANSI mode so the SQL editor ignores the error.
choices.B: Restart the SQL warehouse without inspecting the query.
choices.C: Replace the query with a dashboard visualization.
choices.D: Open Genie Code (formerly Databricks Assistant) and use Diagnose Error to explain the failure and suggest a correction.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Genie Code có thể chẩn đoán lỗi trong SQL Editor, giải thích nguyên nhân và gợi ý truy vấn sửa để người dùng kiểm tra.

questions.question:
A BI analyst is building an analytical data model in Databricks using Delta Lake tables. The source system contains transactional sales data that changes frequently. The analyst chooses to apply the Data Vault 2.0 methodology to manage historical changes while ensuring scalability and auditability across multiple business domains.
Which component is used to capture the many-to-many relationship between hubs in a Data Vault v2 model?

choices.A: Hub Table
choices.B: Satellite Table
choices.C: Link Table
choices.D: Reference Table

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Link table lưu quan hệ nhiều-nhiều giữa các Hub và thường chứa khóa ngoại tham chiếu các Hub liên quan.

questions.question:
A data analyst is using Databricks Unity Catalog. The datasets are tagged by sensitivity, and confidential data is marked with the tag key confidential. The data analyst needs to quickly find all tables tagged as confidential to review their access permissions in the Databricks workspace search bar.
Which search key text should the data analyst use to find these tables?

choices.A: confidential:true
choices.B: tag=confidential
choices.C: tag:confidential
choices.D: search tag = ‘confidential’

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Cú pháp tag:confidential tìm đối tượng có khóa tag confidential; thêm :value nếu cần lọc cả giá trị.

questions.question: How are analytical models mapped to the Gold layer in the Delta Lake medallion architecture on Databricks?

choices.A: The Gold layer is primarily used for storing backup copies of all data for disaster recovery purposes.
choices.B: The Gold layer stores raw, unprocessed data for initial ingestion and schema evolution.
choices.C: The Gold layer is used for data cleaning, deduplication, and joining across domains to establish data integrity.
choices.D: The Gold layer contains de-normalized data models optimized for analytics, reporting, and machine learning.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Gold chứa mô hình đã tuyển chọn, thường phi chuẩn hóa và được tổ chức cho dashboard, báo cáo hoặc mô hình phân tích.

questions.question:
A data team wants to define data transformations declaratively and attach data quality expectations to a production pipeline.
Which Databricks capability is designed for this?

choices.A: Lakeflow Tables
choices.B: Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines
choices.C: Lakeflow Jobs
choices.D: Lakeflow Connect

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines cho phép khai báo bảng và các bước biến đổi, đồng thời gắn expectations để theo dõi hoặc xử lý dòng không đạt. Hành vi với dòng lỗi phụ thuộc vào cách cấu hình expectation.

questions.question: A Delta table has default retention settings. VACUUM ran today and removed the data files required to reconstruct its version from 10 days ago. What happens when a user time-travels to that version?

choices.A: The time travel query will succeed because Delta Lake automatically backs up data for compliance purposes, regardless of VACUUM operations.
choices.B: The time travel query will succeed because the default log retention period is 30 days, which is sufficient to access 10-day-old data.
choices.C: The time travel query will fail because the default maximum table version is 7 and numbering resets after each VACUUM operation, making historical versions inaccessible.
choices.D: The time travel query will fail because the default data file retention period is 7 days, and VACUUM operations have likely removed the required data files.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** VACUUM xóa các tệp không còn được bảng tham chiếu sau thời hạn lưu giữ. Nếu tệp cần cho phiên bản 10 ngày đã bị xóa, time travel thất bại.

questions.question: A Unity Catalog view should expose customer email addresses only to members of the account-level group pii_readers and mask the values for everyone else. Which approach should the analyst use?

choices.A: Grant SELECT on the base table to every report writer and ask them not to select the email column.
choices.B: Create a dynamic view that uses is_account_group_member('pii_readers') to return or mask the email column.
choices.C: Store a CSV on DBFS and rely on folder naming to hide the email column.
choices.D: Overwrite the source emails with masked strings, then restore them manually for authorized users.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Dynamic view có thể dùng is_account_group_member() trong CASE để che cột PII theo nhóm; chỉ cấp quyền cho người dùng trên view.

questions.question: A Unity Catalog table corp_data.reporting.sales_data exists, and the analyst has SELECT on the table plus USE CATALOG on corp_data and USE SCHEMA on reporting. In a SQL warehouse session, SELECT * FROM sales_data; fails with TABLE_OR_VIEW_NOT_FOUND because the current catalog and schema are different. Which action lets the analyst keep the query unqualified?

choices.A: Set spark.databricks.sql.initial.catalog.namespace on the SQL warehouse and assume it updates the current session.
choices.B: Run USE CATALOG corp_data; followed by USE SCHEMA reporting; in the current SQL session.
choices.C: Change the workspace default catalog for every user; this also sets the current schema to reporting.
choices.D: Set spark.sql.default.database to corp_data.reporting.sales_data in the warehouse configuration.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** USE CATALOG và USE SCHEMA đặt namespace mặc định của phiên SQL để tên bảng không đầy đủ được phân giải đúng.

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes privilege inheritance in Unity Catalog?

choices.A: Privileges granted on a catalog or schema can inherit to child objects; most metastore privileges do not inherit, except READ METADATA.
choices.B: All privileges granted on a metastore automatically grant the same access to every catalog and table.
choices.C: Privileges never inherit; each table and view always needs a separate grant.
choices.D: A privilege granted on a schema applies only to the schema object, never to tables inside it.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Quyền cấp ở catalog hoặc schema được kế thừa xuống đối tượng con; hầu hết quyền cấp ở metastore không kế thừa, ngoại trừ READ METADATA.

questions.question: A production analytics table should be governed by Unity Catalog, with Databricks managing its storage and lifecycle. The team also wants automated table maintenance. Which approach is appropriate?

choices.A: Create a foreign table; foreign tables are stored and optimized by Unity Catalog.
choices.B: Create a Unity Catalog managed table and enable predictive optimization for its account, catalog, schema, or table as appropriate.
choices.C: Create a temporary table; it is automatically upgraded to a managed table after the first query.
choices.D: Create an external table; Unity Catalog then owns and deletes the files at the external location.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Managed table để Unity Catalog quản lý vòng đời và lưu trữ. Predictive Optimization có thể tự chạy bảo trì khi được bật cho account hoặc đối tượng.

questions.question: Which statement about Databricks disk caching is true?

choices.A: Disk caching is most effective for nondeterministic SQL queries such as those using RAND().
choices.B: Disk cache is designed to cache every CSV and JSON file as decoded table rows.
choices.C: Disk cache automatically keeps local copies of remote Parquet files, including Parquet data used by Delta tables.
choices.D: Spark cache always improves performance, so every DataFrame should be cached.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Disk cache tự lưu bản sao cục bộ của tệp Parquet từ S3, ABFS và các hệ thống tệp khác; Delta Lake cũng dùng Parquet nên được hỗ trợ.

questions.question: A research institution has no Databricks workspace. It needs read-only access to only selected Unity Catalog tables through an OpenSharing-compatible client. What should the provider do?

choices.A: Add every researcher to the provider workspace and grant workspace access.
choices.B: Export the whole catalog to CSV and email it to the institution.
choices.C: Grant the external institution USE CATALOG directly on the provider metastore.
choices.D: Create an OpenSharing share with only the approved tables, create an open recipient, and deliver its credentials securely.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** OpenSharing (tên trước đây là Delta Sharing) chia sẻ đúng các bảng được chọn ở chế độ chỉ đọc cho recipient bên ngoài; recipient có thể đọc bằng client tương thích mà không cần workspace Databricks.

questions.question: An analyst edits an existing AI/BI dashboard and wants to add a counter showing the percentage of on-time shipments. What is the correct workflow?

choices.A: Export a notebook chart as an image and upload the image as a dashboard visualization.
choices.B: Ask an administrator to create a materialized view because dashboards cannot calculate percentages.
choices.C: Add a visualization to the dashboard, use a dataset that calculates the percentage, choose a counter, then save the draft.
choices.D: Clone the dashboard because an existing dashboard cannot accept more visualizations.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Chỉnh sửa dashboard, thêm visualization từ dataset phù hợp, cấu hình kiểu biểu đồ và lưu bản nháp.

questions.question:
A data analyst needs to improve the performance of a daily sales report that aggregates data from a large transactions table. The report is run multiple times a day, but the underlying data only changes once daily.
Which approach should the analyst use to improve performance while minimizing redundant computation?

choices.A: Use a standard view and schedule a notebook to cache results.
choices.B: Create a materialized view that precomputes the daily sales aggregation.
choices.C: Use a dynamic view to compute the aggregation on each query.
choices.D: Set up a streaming table to ingest new sales data in real time.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Materialized view lưu kết quả tổng hợp để tái sử dụng; dữ liệu ít thay đổi giúp giảm tính toán lặp cho báo cáo.

questions.question: The developers group must no longer use Unity Catalog catalog finance_catalog. Which command revokes that catalog access privilege?

choices.A: REVOKE USAGE ON CATALOG finance_catalog FROM developers;
choices.B: ALTER CATALOG finance_catalog DROP PERMISSIONS FOR developers;
choices.C: REVOKE USE CATALOG ON CATALOG finance_catalog FROM developers;
choices.D: REVOKE USE CATALOG ON SCHEMA finance_catalog FROM developers;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** USE CATALOG là quyền cần thu hồi để ngăn nhóm truy cập catalog; USAGE không phải privilege Unity Catalog hiện hành.

questions.question:
A data analyst needs to join two tables, orders and customers, using both customer_id and region_id as join keys. The goal is to return only rows where both values match in the two tables.
Which SQL query correctly performs this join?

choices.A: SELECT * FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id;
choices.B: SELECT * FROM orders INNER JOIN customers USING (customer_id);
choices.C: SELECT * FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id AND orders.region_id = customers.region_id;
choices.D: SELECT * FROM orders LEFT JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id AND orders.region_id = customers.region_id;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** INNER JOIN chỉ giữ cặp dòng khớp và điều kiện ON phải so sánh cả customer_id lẫn region_id.

questions.question: An analyst reviews a Genie Agent used by operations managers and sees that several responses were flagged as inaccurate. What should they do to improve answer quality?

choices.A: Add every table and column because more data always improves answer quality.
choices.B: Refine the instructions and add verified example SQL queries to clarify business context.
choices.C: Turn off feedback because it trains the Genie Agent incorrectly.
choices.D: Delete the flagged responses to erase them from the model.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Hướng dẫn miền nghiệp vụ và query ví dụ cung cấp thuật ngữ, phép nối và logic cần thiết để Genie sinh SQL đúng hơn.

questions.question: Which SQL statement assigns the Unity Catalog certification status deprecated to table main.analytics.sales_data?

choices.A: SET TAG ON TABLE main.analytics.sales_data `system.certification_status` = `deprecated`;
choices.B: UPDATE TABLE main.analytics.sales_data ADD COMMENT 'Deprecated dataset';
choices.C: ALTER TABLE main.analytics.sales_data SET TBLPROPERTIES ('system.certification_status' = 'deprecated');
choices.D: ALTER TABLE main.analytics.sales_data SET TAGS ('system.certification_status' = 'deprecated');
