questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Tag system.certification_status = deprecated đánh dấu đối tượng là không còn được khuyến nghị; đây là governed tag của Unity Catalog.

questions.question: A data analyst is curating a Genie Agent for the marketing team with governed tables, clear instructions, and example questions. What additional step can improve trust and reuse for common questions?

choices.A: Disable domain instructions to avoid influencing generated answers.
choices.B: Mark verified, frequently used queries or functions as trusted assets.
choices.C: Enable automatic query generation without reviewing results.
choices.D: Let users edit the underlying datasets to improve answers.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Đánh dấu truy vấn đã kiểm chứng là Trusted Asset giúp Genie tái dùng câu trả lời SQL đáng tin cho các câu hỏi quen thuộc.

questions.question: Return only product categories with more than 10 products and an average price greater than $50. Which query correctly filters these aggregate results?

choices.A: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 AND AVG(price) > 50;
choices.B: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE COUNT(*) > 10 GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(price) > 50;
choices.C: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 GROUP BY category WHERE AVG(price) > 50;
choices.D: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category WHERE COUNT(*) > 10 AND AVG(price) > 50;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** GROUP BY tạo một nhóm cho mỗi category; HAVING lọc các nhóm bằng COUNT và AVG sau khi tổng hợp.

questions.question:
A data analyst wants to implement a use case that requires managing both structured and unstructured data.
How will Unity Catalog help in this scenario?

choices.A: It allows for the management of both structured data and unstructured data through objects such as tables and volumes.
choices.B: It requires all unstructured data to be converted into Delta Lake format before it can be managed.
choices.C: It can catalog data coming from relational databases, excluding files and non-tabular data.
choices.D: It manages structured data in tabular format and unstructured files like images in blob storage.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Unity Catalog quản lý dữ liệu dạng bảng bằng tables/views và tệp phi cấu trúc bằng volumes.

questions.question: order_quantity can be a valid integer, -1 for an erroneous entry, or NULL for an unknown quantity. Which predicate excludes -1 while retaining NULL rows?

choices.A: order_quantity IS NOT NULL AND order_quantity <> -1
choices.B: ABS(order_quantity) <> 1
choices.C: HAVING order_quantity <> -1
choices.D: order_quantity IS NULL OR order_quantity <> -1

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Điều kiện giữ lại giá trị NULL hoặc mọi order_quantity khác -1, nên chỉ loại các dòng có giá trị lỗi -1.

questions.question:
A data analyst is building a parameterized SQL query in Databricks to filter sales data by region and year. The analyst wants to test the query with different parameter values before adding it to a dashboard.
Which approach should the analyst use to allow for dynamic testing of the parameters in the Databricks SQL editor?

choices.A: Hard-code the region and year values directly into the SQL query and rerun it for each test.
choices.B: Use parameter markers (e.g., :region, :year) in the SQL query and enter their values in the input boxes before running the query.
choices.C: Replace the column names (e.g., region, year) with question marks (“?”) and expect Databricks to prompt for values at runtime.
choices.D: Add the parameters as variables in a Python notebook cell and reference them in the SQL query.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Named parameter markers như :region và :year tạo widget để nhập giá trị khi chạy query trong SQL Editor.

questions.question: What is the primary role of a SQL Warehouse in Databricks?

choices.A: SQL Warehouses are primarily used for ETL operations and data transformations, offering better performance for batch processing compared to interactive queries
choices.B: SQL Warehouses are specialized compute resources designed specifically for SQL query execution, powered by the Photon engine for accelerated performance and optimized for BI tool integration
choices.C: SQL Warehouses are general-purpose compute resources that support Python, Scala, R, and SQL workloads, with automatic library management and custom runtime configurations for enhanced performance
choices.D: SQL Warehouses function as data storage systems that maintain cached query results and provide direct access to Delta tables without requiring additional compute resources

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** SQL warehouse là compute chuyên cho truy vấn SQL và workload BI; Photon tăng tốc thực thi các toán tử được hỗ trợ.

questions.question: Where should an analyst add a sample business question and its matching SQL query to improve a Genie Agent’s answers?

choices.A: Create a notebook per question and attach each notebook to the Genie Agent.
choices.B: Put the questions in the Genie Agent description; it will infer the matching SQL.
choices.C: Upload a spreadsheet of questions but store the SQL mappings separately.
choices.D: Open Configure > Examples and add an example query with a natural-language title and matching SQL.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Trong Configure > Examples, thêm câu hỏi mẫu cùng SQL tương ứng; Genie dùng ví dụ để khớp và suy rộng cách xử lý câu hỏi tương tự.

questions.question: A dashboard is slow. Which Databricks SQL tool shows past query executions, duration, rows and bytes read, and links to a query profile?

choices.A: Dashboard Editor, which reports SQL operator and scan metrics for every run.
choices.B: Lakehouse Monitoring, which profiles a dashboard query over time.
choices.C: Query Profile, which aggregates long-term history across all executions.
choices.D: Query History, which lists runs and opens per-run metrics and Query Profile.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Query History có các lần chạy, thời lượng, dữ liệu đọc, số dòng và liên kết đến Query Profile để chẩn đoán từng lần thực thi.

questions.question: A BI team wants external users with no Databricks workspace account to ask natural-language questions of a Genie Agent from the team’s own application. Which approach should it use?

choices.A: Integrate the Genie Conversation API in the external application and authenticate the backend with an authorized service identity.
choices.B: Embed a Genie Agent in an externally embedded dashboard; Ask Genie is supported there without authentication.
choices.C: Email a CSV export of the Genie tables and ask users to upload it to Databricks.
choices.D: Create a workspace account for every external viewer; the Conversation API cannot be used by applications.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Ứng dụng bên ngoài gọi Genie Conversation API bằng danh tính dịch vụ phù hợp; Unity Catalog vẫn kiểm soát quyền trên dữ liệu.

questions.question:
A company uses a star schema for sales analysis. The sales fact table records transactions, while product, store, and date dimensions each contain one row per entity.
Which key relationship represents this conventional design?

choices.A: The fact table and dimension tables are joined using arbitrary columns, and primary/foreign key relationships are not required in a star schema.
choices.B: The fact table contains primary keys that directly match the primary keys in each dimension table, allowing for one-to-one joins.
choices.C: Both fact and dimension tables use only foreign keys, and joins are performed using non-unique columns.
choices.D: Each dimension table has a primary key, which is referenced as a foreign key in the fact table. This structure allows the fact table to join with multiple dimension tables for analytical queries.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Mỗi dimension có khóa chính duy nhất; fact lưu khóa ngoại tham chiếu đến các dimension, nên nhiều dòng fact có thể liên kết với một dòng dimension. Trong Unity Catalog, khai báo PK/FK chỉ mang tính thông tin và không tự kiểm tra dữ liệu; cần kiểm tra chất lượng riêng.

questions.question:
A BI analyst is designing a Databricks SQL dashboard that tracks monthly revenue for three product categories across two years. Leadership wants a chart that makes it straightforward to compare each category’s trend over time and quickly spot seasonal patterns or declines without relying on additional filters or calculations.
Which visualization type in Databricks SQL will clearly communicate the revenue trends and category comparisons described?

choices.A: Multi-series line chart plotting month on the x-axis and revenue on the y-axis for each category.
choices.B: Single-value counter displaying combined revenue for the entire two-year period.
choices.C: Pie chart showing each category’s percentage of total revenue for the final month.
choices.D: Scatter chart with revenue on the x-axis and profit margin on the y-axis for all transactions.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Line chart nhiều chuỗi thể hiện xu hướng doanh thu theo tháng và cho phép so sánh các danh mục qua thời gian.

questions.question:
A data engineer continuously ingests semi-structured log files from S3 and wants incremental discovery with schema evolution enabled and minimal custom code.
Which approach best fits?

choices.A: Build a custom Spark Structured Streaming job that tracks processed files via checkpointing and manual schema management.
choices.B: Use Auto Loader to incrementally ingest data from S3.
choices.C: Build a custom API-driven ingestion pipeline to pull data from S3.
choices.D: Use Delta Sharing to share data with Databricks from external systems.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Auto Loader phát hiện và nạp các tệp mới theo kiểu incremental. Cần cấu hình schema inference/evolution và schemaLocation phù hợp; trong Lakeflow pipeline, nền tảng có thể quản lý metadata schema và checkpoint.

questions.question:
A data analyst needs to quickly estimate the number of unique user sessions in a dataset containing billions of records on Databricks SQL. Due to performance constraints, the analyst must ensure the query runs efficiently and delivers results with acceptable accuracy.
What is the primary advantage of using APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT instead of COUNT_DISTINCT in this scenario?

choices.A: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT provides exact counts, while COUNT DISTINCT only provides estimates.
choices.B: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT can only be used with string columns, while COUNT DISTINCT works with numeric columns.
choices.C: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT uses the HyperLogLog++ algorithm to provide fast approximate counts with configurable accuracy (default 5% relative standard deviation).
choices.D: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT requires less memory by storing only the first 1000 unique values.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT dùng HyperLogLog++ để ước lượng nhanh với bộ nhớ thấp; relativeSD mặc định là 5%.

questions.question:
A data analyst is evaluating options to optimize query performance on a large table with frequently changing query filters. The analyst is considering using Liquid Clustering versus traditional Hive-style partitioning.
What is the primary advantage of Liquid Clustering over traditional partitioning for tables with evolving query patterns?

choices.A: Liquid Clustering provides better compression ratios than partitioned tables, reducing storage costs.
choices.B: Liquid Clustering allows changing clustering columns without rewriting existing data, while partitioning requires reprocessing and rewriting data to change the partitioning structure.
choices.C: Liquid Clustering automatically creates backup copies of data files, while partitioning does not.
choices.D: Liquid Clustering supports more data types than partitioning, including nested structures and arrays.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B.** Có thể đổi clustering keys để phù hợp mẫu truy vấn mới mà không cần định nghĩa lại partition layout của toàn bảng. Các tệp cũ không được sắp xếp lại ngay; OPTIMIZE sẽ recluster dữ liệu theo keys mới.

questions.question: The analyst wants to improve Genie’s interpretation of ambiguous column names such as region_code and channel_type. Which two actions directly add business semantics to the space? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Enable representative-value sampling only; do not describe what the columns mean.
choices.B: Write instructions mapping business terms such as region and channel to the corresponding fields.
choices.C: Add every available column, including unrelated fields, to the space.
choices.D: Add clear column descriptions and business synonyms in Unity Catalog.
choices.E: Add query examples without describing the business terms or columns.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án B và D.** Hướng dẫn ánh xạ thuật ngữ nghiệp vụ và mô tả cột hoặc synonym giúp Genie hiểu các tên mơ hồ như region_code và channel_type. Lấy mẫu giá trị và thêm query ví dụ có thể bổ trợ, nhưng không trực tiếp định nghĩa ngữ nghĩa của cột.

questions.question: A company wants to show an AI/BI dashboard inside its external customer portal. Viewers have no Databricks accounts, and access must be authenticated and audited. Which approach is designed for this?

choices.A: Publish the dashboard and implement external-user embedding with a service principal, OAuth, approved domains, and appropriate data permissions.
choices.B: Share the workspace link and grant each external viewer workspace administrator access.
choices.C: Add external users to the All workspace users group without creating identities.
choices.D: Export a PDF once and use it as a live interactive dashboard.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** External embedding dùng ứng dụng trung gian với service principal và OAuth; cấu hình domain được phép cùng quyền dữ liệu cần thiết, không cần workspace account cho từng người xem.

questions.question: Which components help configure an effective Genie Agent that returns accurate, governed answers to natural-language questions?

choices.A: An external warehouse that replicates all Unity Catalog data.
choices.B: A separate chatbot application and custom API for every user.
choices.C: Well-annotated Unity Catalog datasets, sample queries, and domain-specific instructions.
choices.D: A dedicated physical server for each Genie Agent.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Genie cần dữ liệu được quản lý trong Unity Catalog cùng metadata, câu hỏi/SQL mẫu và hướng dẫn miền nghiệp vụ.

questions.question:
A company has started using the Databricks Platform and currently has only one workspace. They need to manage data access across different teams and want to ensure proper isolation and security controls.
Given this setup, which approach should be used?

choices.A: Create a unique catalog with all schemas inside of it.
choices.B: Use Unity Catalog’s built-in environment separation features.
choices.C: Create a schema and share the schema for production, development, and testing.
choices.D: Create a catalog for production, another for development, and another for testing.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Tách catalog theo môi trường tạo ranh giới namespace để quản lý grant độc lập. Cần cấp quyền thích hợp trên từng catalog; việc tạo catalog riêng không tự động cô lập quyền truy cập.

questions.question:
A data analyst is exploring user engagement trends and wants to create a visualization while working interactively in a Databricks notebook. The analyst executes a SQL query using %sql and wants to turn the result into a line chart showing weekly user counts over time.
Which step allows the analyst to create the chart directly in the notebook?

choices.A: Save the query as a table, export it to Excel, and use Excel’s charting tools.
choices.B: Wrap the SQL query in a Python plotly.express call using %python.
choices.C: Use %sql to run the query, then copy the result into a new dashboard to access visualization options.
choices.D: Use the display() function or %sql to run the query, then click the + icon in the result cell to add a visualization.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Sau khi chạy SQL hoặc display() trong notebook, dùng nút thêm visualization tại kết quả để cấu hình biểu đồ ngay trong notebook.

questions.question:
A data analyst needs to generate a sales report by joining a Unity Catalog-managed table with a table stored in a MySQL database. The analyst wants the join to be efficient, performed within Databricks, and governed using Unity Catalog permissions and lineage.
Which approach should the data analyst use to meet these requirements?

choices.A: Use Lakehouse Federation to create a foreign catalog for the MySQL database, then write a SQL query joining the Delta table and the federated MySQL table directly in Databricks.
choices.B: Write a Python script to connect to both sources separately, download the data and join them in memory outside Databricks.
choices.C: Fully ingest the MySQL table into Databricks and store it as a new Delta table before joining.
choices.D: Register the MySQL table as a temporary view in Databricks using a standard Spark JDBC read, then join it with the Unity Catalog-managed table using Databricks SQL.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A.** Lakehouse Federation đăng ký MySQL dưới dạng foreign catalog để truy vấn qua Unity Catalog và kết hợp với bảng Delta trong Databricks. Connector có thể đẩy các phần truy vấn được hỗ trợ về nguồn, nhưng không bảo đảm toàn bộ phép join được thực thi tại MySQL.

questions.question: A data analyst needs to query Parquet files directly in an S3 bucket and register them as a Unity Catalog table without copying the files. Assume the path is covered by a configured external location and the analyst has the required privileges to create an external table there. Which SQL statement is correct?

choices.A: CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name USING PARQUET AS SELECT * FROM parquet.`s3://my-bucket/data/`;
choices.B: CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name OPTIONS ('path' 's3://my-bucket/data/') STORED AS PARQUET;
choices.C: CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE catalog.schema.table_name USING DELTA LOCATION 's3://my-bucket/data/';
choices.D: CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name USING PARQUET LOCATION 's3://my-bucket/data/';

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** USING PARQUET LOCATION tạo external table trỏ đến thư mục Parquet đã có; Unity Catalog quản lý quyền trên metadata của bảng.

questions.question: A team is migrating Spark SQL and DataFrame workloads to Databricks. Which two statements accurately describe how Photon can improve supported workloads? (Choose two.)

choices.A: Photon is Spark API-compatible, so supported workloads can often benefit without code changes.
choices.B: Photon executes data row by row to maximize compatibility with legacy systems.
choices.C: Photon automatically parallelizes every query across multiple independent clusters.
choices.D: Photon merges every small file into one large file before each query.
choices.E: Photon uses a native vectorized columnar engine to accelerate supported scans and aggregations.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án A và E.** Photon dùng engine native vector hóa theo cột để tăng tốc scan và aggregation; nó tương thích với Spark API nên workload hiện tại thường không cần sửa mã.

questions.question:
An analyst needs external datasets and analytics assets to enrich their lakehouse reporting. The organization uses Databricks with Unity Catalog enabled and wants fast, governed access to third-party data without complex ETL or replication.
What is the benefit of using Databricks Marketplace in this context?

choices.A: It is a marketplace for purchasing compute resources managed outside Unity Catalog.
choices.B: It schedules ETL pipelines that copy partner data into proprietary formats.
choices.C: It requires analysts to copy shared data into their workspace for offline analysis.
choices.D: It enables governed discovery and access to external data and analytics assets through OpenSharing (formerly Delta Sharing), without manual replication.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Marketplace phân phối dữ liệu và tài sản analytics có quản trị; OpenSharing (tên trước đây là Delta Sharing) cho phép dùng dữ liệu bên ngoài mà không phải sao chép thủ công.

questions.question:
A data analyst uses Databricks to create a dashboard that monitors daily sales volumes and store performance. To ensure that area managers always see up-to-date data without having to manually intervene, the data analyst wants to automate the dashboard data refresh.
Which process should the data analyst use to automatically refresh the data displayed, avoiding manual intervention?

choices.A: Set the Dashboard query to ‘auto-update’ by using a browser extension that reloads the tab at set intervals.
choices.B: Export the dashboard as a PDF the night before, so the team can see “recent” data the next day.
choices.C: Use the dashboard’s built-in scheduling option to set an automatic refresh at regular intervals.
choices.D: Ask all users to press the “Refresh” button on the dashboard whenever they want updated data.

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án C.** Schedule tích hợp chạy lại dataset và làm mới kết quả theo chu kỳ đã chọn.

questions.question:
A data analyst needs to automate scheduled ETL jobs that ingest and transform data from multiple sources. The analyst wants to use multiple programming languages for flexibility and ensure that the pipeline can automatically handle schema changes as new data arrives.
Which approach in Databricks should be used to meet this requirement?

choices.A: Databricks Workflows with Apache Spark notebooks and manual schema management
choices.B: Unity Catalog with manual ETL scripts and cron-based scheduling
choices.C: Separate Delta tables for each data source with fixed schemas
choices.D: Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines with Auto Loader

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines định nghĩa pipeline bằng SQL hoặc Python; Auto Loader phát hiện tệp mới và xử lý tiến hóa schema.

questions.question:
A data analyst is given a sales table with the columns product_id, sale_date, and sale_amount. The analyst’s goal is to calculate the total sales per product per day, with exactly one row per product per day.
They first try the following SQL query:
SELECT product_id, sale_date, sale_amount, SUM(sale_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date) AS daily_total FROM sales ORDER BY product_id, sale_date;
However, this produces multiple rows for the same product and date instead of one aggregated row per product/date combination.
Which corrected SQL query will produce exactly one row per product per day with the total sales for that day?

choices.A: SELECT product_id, sale_date, SUM(sale_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date) AS daily_total FROM sales;
choices.B: SELECT product_id, SUM(sale_amount) AS daily_total FROM sales GROUP BY product_id;
choices.C: SELECT product_id, sale_date, sale_amount, SUM(sale_amount) AS daily_total FROM sales GROUP BY product_id, sale_date, sale_amount;
choices.D: SELECT product_id, sale_date, SUM(sale_amount) AS daily_total FROM sales GROUP BY product_id, sale_date;

questions.explanation_vi: **Đáp án D.** GROUP BY product_id, sale_date gộp các giao dịch thành một nhóm cho mỗi sản phẩm-ngày; SUM tính tổng trong từng nhóm.
